basis: v23 prespecified developmental F08 packet; no new pretraining or G3/G4
stream_seed: SeedSequence([continuation, 803, ord(suite), original_seed, checkpoint_step]); same stream within all eight conditions
dose: 16-episode shuffled blocks: focus quotas4,7,10,13 and other task quotas4,3,2,1. Five blocks =80 episodes.
order: Ten shuffled8-episode blocks. i/j focus5+1+1+1. First5i then5j; reverse; alternating i,j; or mixture3i+3j+1+1. All order conditions totals30i+30j+10+10.
parent: Exact existing suite seed12 200k full SAC/optimizer/alpha/replay/collector state; continuation RNG reset once at start; switches never reset replay/optimizer/RNG.
banks: Fresh bank per suite:20 D and100 O cases/task, hash/seed/task-parameter disjoint from historical evaluation/training and F05 bank. Initial D diagnostic retained; initial and final O evaluate first success or500. Same O across all conditions.
analysis: Paired final macro and task changes; dose4375/dose625 minus linear interpolation of endpoints25/8125. i_then_j minus j_then_i; alternate4k and each order minus mixture. All predefined contrasts reported, no best-condition-only result.
uncertainty: All3 continuation differences reported separately. Case-only paired bootstrap5000 with policies fixed; no original-seed confidence claim (one original seed12 only).
screen: Descriptive effect>=1pp and same sign in>=2/3 continuations in a suite is a lead, not generalization. No winner-dependent early stopping; all72 branches run unless technical integrity fails or retries exhausted.
recovery: Unique attempt dirs; immutable full20k/40k checkpoints. Resume successful20k segment; preserve incomplete attempts. Three attempts maximum for transient failure, integrity failures stop immediately. No outcome-dependent retry.
limits: Developmental pair/seed chosen in prior design after historical observations; one original seed; no cost-inclusive adaptive allocation or independent confirmatory claim.
